name: The Legashi Threat
summary: Ekkal asks you to defend the Blackmaw furbolg from Legashi satyr at the Ruins of Eldarath. The satyr have corrupted members of the tribe and driven survivors into makeshift camps.

sections.title: A Tribe Under Threat
sections.body: Ekkal asks for your aid at the Ruins of Eldarath, where Legashi satyr have invaded the Blackmaw den. Their corruption has taken hold among the furbolg and severed the tribe from its Timbermaw allies. Survivors now gather in makeshift camps, while the corruption spreads across the land. Ekkal hopes each Legashi slain will spare a furbolg life.

faq.answer: Ekkal asks you to help defend the Blackmaw furbolg from the Legashi satyr.

faq.q: What are the Legashi doing to the Blackmaw?
faq.answer: The Legashi have invaded the Blackmaw den, corrupted many furbolg, and separated the tribe from its Timbermaw allies.
Ekkal says the Legashi lurk among the ruins northeast of the Blackmaw den.

faq.q: Which Legashi does Ekkal want you to defeat?
faq.answer: Ekkal asks you to defeat Legashi Satyr, Legashi Rogues, and Legashi Hellcallers.

faq.q: Why does Ekkal ask for help?
faq.answer: The Legashi threaten the already vulnerable Blackmaw tribe, and Ekkal believes each one slain may save a furbolg life.
